description: Initial HTTP/1 hot-path autoresearch setup: first baseline failed due to benchmark script issues in request body attribute and header decoding corpus
Set up HTTP/1 hot-path autoresearch harness, focused checks, and baseline benchmark
Replace request header validation comprehensions with byte-recursive scans to cut allocations in Request.encode/4
Cache lowercase strings for common atom header names in HTTP/1 response decoding
Try a manual ASCII content-length parser to replace trim-and-Integer.parse in HTTP/1 header parsing
Replace content-length trim-plus-parse with a manual ASCII parser in Mint.HTTP1.Parse
Build connection and transfer-encoding tokens via byte lists instead of binary appends in HTTP/1 parsing
Restore the original header validators after confirming the recursive request-path rewrite was a regression
Encode HTTP/1 headers with a reversed iolist builder instead of nested Enum.reduce output
Replace String.downcase(:ascii) with a custom ASCII binary builder in header normalization
Build HTTP/1 header iodata directly with recursive clauses instead of reversing an accumulator
Fast-path content-length parsing by skipping trim_trailing unless the final byte is whitespace
Inline common HTTP/1 atom header mappings directly in Response.decode_header/1
Specialize Request.encode/4 for nil and :stream bodies to avoid the extra encode_body/1 hop
Split binary and uncommon-atom fallbacks in Response.decode_header/1 to avoid the generic helper dispatch
Inline request-line iodata in Request.encode/4 to remove the encode_request_line/2 helper call
Ask the compiler to inline downcase_ascii_char/1 in the HTTP/1 token parser
